description: Find invisible characters, bidi controls (Trojan Source), hidden Unicode tag payloads (decoded), variation-selector runs, control characters, unusual spaces, mixed-script words and lookalike letters. ZWJ/ZWNJ/VS16 in legitimate context (emoji sequences, Persian/Arabic joining, Indic virama) are reported as info joiner_in_context and do not raise risk; elsewhere they stay medium. Lone surrogates are flagged. Returns a risk level (none/low/medium/high), counts, and findings with UTF-16 offsets and code points. Read-only. Same engine as GET /api/scan.

text.description: Text to inspect (up to 2000 UTF-16 code units).

name: scan_text
title: Scan text for hidden or deceptive Unicode
